pairs.l: 1  I got stuck in the traffic so I’m going to be a bit late. Don’t leave without me.
2  The talk show starts at 8. I’ll wait for you at the entrance to the studio. Don’t forget that once the cameras are on, you can’t enter.
3  I’ve got the chance to study abroad, but I’d have to leave my job here. What should I do? I need an answer soon.
pairs.r: F — Tell me what you think.

pairs.l: 4  I apologize. I was rude and selfish, but I really care about you. Please let me prove it to you.
5  Sorry I had to run off, but our discussion is not over. I want to tell you what I think.
pairs.r: D — I’ll talk to you later.

r1.exp: 1→B (zapeo u prometu, ne odlazi bez njega = Wait for me), 2→E (talk show u 8, dođi na vrijeme = Don’t be late), 3→F (trebam savjet, što misliš? = Tell me what you think), 4→A (ispriku, daj mi još jednu šansu = Give me another chance), 5→D (razgovor nije gotov, reći ću ti što mislim = I’ll talk to you later). C suvišan.

r6.exp: Grace pobijedi lako, svi su ponosni, ali ona samo kaže “bila je sretna”. “That’s so typical of her” → skromna (modest).

r7.exp: Sondra je bila ponosna na svoju kolekciju torbica, ali kad ih je prebrojila, “she couldn’t believe how many she’d got” → bila je zapanjena/u šoku (shocked).

r8.exp: Beryl je potrošila €13 na torbu + €17 na traperice = €30 ukupno. To je bila njezina ušteđevina.

r9.exp: Zoe i Harriet dogovorile su se u kafiću, ali Zoe kaže: “when I showed her the dress I’d just bought in the boutique next door” → prvo je bila u butigu.

r10.exp: “I’d definitely buy one if I had the money.” → nema novca = preskup (too expensive).

r11.exp: “After switching to biochemistry, he spent the summer researching the parasite that causes malaria” → diplom iz biokemije. Prihvatljivo: Biochemistry / biochemistry.

r12.exp: “He had already been a waiter to get work experience” → prvi posao = konobar. Prihvatljivo: Waiter / (a) waiter.

r13.exp: “When the local car factory closed, there was no more work for mechanics like him” → očev posao = mehaničar. Prihvatljivo: Mechanic / Car mechanic / car mechanic.

r14.exp: “He still enjoys cooking, but now only for fun.” → hobi = kuhanje. Prihvatljivo: Cooking / cooking.

r15.exp: “The person I looked up to was Charles Darwin. I wanted to be just like him.” → idol = Charles Darwin.

pairs.l: 17  ...when he saw her at Jade’s party, ___

pairs.r: C — that it was not what she wanted

pairs.l: 19  ...she felt it was important ___ and not be in a restrictive relationship
pairs.r: F — to be free to see other people

pairs.l: 20  ...she tried to find him, but it was too late — ___

r16.exp: 16→D (raskinuo je jer je izašla s drugim dečkom), 17→A (kad ju je vidio na zabavi, otišao je iz sobe), 18→C (mrzila je pomisao da to nije ono što želi), 19→F (smatrala je važnim biti slobodna), 20→B (prekasno — već je otišao). E suvišan.

r21.exp: Pasiv s agensom: “given by an aunt” = dobio od tetke. U pasivu koristimo ‘by’ za vršitelja radnje.

r22.exp: “Have a clue what it was for” = znati za što je. Upitna zamjenica ‘what’ uvodi zavisnu upitn.šnicu.

r23.exp: “Doing magic tricks” = izvoditi mačionarske trikove. Fiksna kolokacija: ‘do a trick’.

r24.exp: “Invest money in” = uložiti novac u nešto. Fiksna kolokacija ‘invest in’.

r25.exp: “She had died before I started” = umrla je prije nego što sam počeo. Past perfect + before.

r26.exp: “More than 90,000” = više od 90.000. Komparativ s ‘more’ zahtijeva ‘than’.

r27.exp: “Recognised by instruments” = prepoznaju ga uređaji. Pasiv + agent = ‘by’.

r28.exp: “A convoy whose speed is fixed” = konvoj čija je brzina fiksna. Posvojni relativizator ‘whose’. Prihvatljivo: whose / where.

r29.exp: Frazalni glagol: “pick up information” = primiti/pokupiti informacije.

r30.exp: Fiksna fraza: “at the same time” = u isto vrijeme.

sol.ans: Referentni odgovor mora: (1) objasniti kako doći od kolodvora do stana (opis puta / prijevoz), (2) gdje naći ključ (npr. kod susjeda / ispod prostirke), (3) jedan ili više savjeta (npr. o sigurnosti, tržnici, prijevozu). 50–70 riječi, neformalan ton.

A — I have less to do than you.
